outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and fluorescence photographs of whole lungs (ex vivo imaging), not a data plot.
Bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity ± SD, with individual mouse data points (blue and red dots) overlaid on the bars.

The Cd68 and Spp1 panels are spatial expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections, not summary bar/point plots requiring individual data point overlay; the other images in this panel (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) are micrographs, not plots.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual data points on this plot type is not applicable/would not be meaningful.

Bar graph showing log2 fold change for each gene with only p-values annotated; no individual data points (e.g., per-spot expression values) are overlaid to indicate variability underlying the fold-change estimates.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrographs/photographs of lung sections, not a quantitative summary plot.
